m1.typescript: m1 every job of the bank gets its mechanism its reason and its interval

e1.typescript: e1 a pipeline job is a headless run whatever else is true

e2.typescript: e2 a condition or a background command decides before an event and an event is watched unless it must run unattended

e3.typescript: e3 a one off job fires in the session unless the machine is off or the session is closed

e4.typescript: e4 a cloud schedule is refused below one hour and a desktop schedule below one minute

e5.typescript: e5 a fixed loop rounds seconds up to whole minutes and no interval means self paced

e6.typescript: e6 a recurring loop lasts seven days so a longer job needs a durable home

e7.typescript: e7 an unknown value is an error a cloud run cannot see local files and a missing key takes its default

wrong-ci-only-for-intervals.defect: treats a pipeline job as headless only when it also runs on an interval

wrong-event-always-watched.defect: watches an event in the session even when it must run with nobody present

wrong-event-polled.defect: polls an event on a fixed loop instead of watching its output

wrong-seconds-floor.defect: rounds seconds down to whole minutes instead of up

wrong-no-expiry.defect: keeps a job on a loop after the seven days a recurring task lasts

wrong-cloud-any-interval.defect: accepts a cloud schedule that runs more often than hourly

wrong-once-ignores-machine-off.defect: fires a one off job in the session even when the machine will be off

wrong-closed-session-ignored.defect: keeps a job on a loop when no session will be open

wrong-selfpaced-as-minute.defect: turns a job without an interval into a one minute loop

wrong-no-validation.defect: accepts a trigger it does not know

wrong-cloud-sees-local-files.defect: lets a cloud run read local files
